For buyers · What searchers earn
is the aggregate search fund return one university publishes. Another puts the weighted average at 2.50 times. Each is right about what it measured.

Stanford Graduate School of Business, 2026 Search Fund Study, data to 31 December 2025: more than 850 funds in the United States and Canada. Yale School of Management, How are Search Fund Investors Really Faring?, 27 October 2025: 1,192 observations from 12 investors in 23 funds. Yale does not say the Stanford figure is wrong; it argues that it is a population index no single investor can replicate. Both are shown; neither is preferred here.

The evidence on one target, before the letter is priced.
This is non-attest preparation.
Earnings, traced
Revenue reconciled to bank deposits, and reported earnings tied to the records behind them.
Every adjustment, marked
Each add-back in the seller’s presentation marked supported or unsupported, with the document that decides it.
Customers and contracts
Concentration, retention and contract terms, including what transfers on a change of ownership.
A findings report
What was found and what it affects, before you price the letter. Scope and fee are agreed in writing before any work begins.
